name: Lengthening over nail (LON)

card.summary: Hybrid limb-lengthening technique that pairs an external fixator with an intramedullary nail to shorten frame time; studied in cosmetic and non-cosmetic series.
card.note: Still a major surgery with a documented complication profile; evidence for cosmetic use comes from case series and a systematic review.

quick.overview:
Lengthening over nail combines an intramedullary nail inside the bone with an external fixator used for the lengthening phase. The nail carries the load during healing, so the frame can be removed earlier than in conventional Ilizarov lengthening.

It is one of the surgical routes discussed for cosmetic height increase, alongside fully internal motorised nails. Studies include a randomised comparison with conventional Ilizarov lengthening, a comparison with internal kinetic distraction, and case series of cosmetic lower limb lengthening.
quick.mechanism: The bone is cut and gradually distracted by the external frame while the nail is in place; after the target length is reached the frame is removed and the nail is locked, leaving the nail to stabilise the bone through consolidation.
quick.risks: Reported complications are discussed in cosmetic-lengthening reviews and individual series. One study found that reamed nailing can adversely affect bone regeneration during distraction. Pin infections, delayed healing and rehabilitation demands are described. Regulation of cosmetic lengthening varies by country.

lead: Lengthening over nail (LON) is a limb-lengthening technique in which an intramedullary nail is placed in the bone and an external fixator is used for distraction, after which the fixator is removed while the nail remains [1][3]. It was developed to minimise the time patients wear a frame during femur lengthening [1].

A prospective randomised study of 31 limbs compared LON with conventional Ilizarov lengthening on length gain, external fixation index, consolidation index and complications [3]. A 2012 study compared LON with intramedullary skeletal kinetic distraction in femoral lengthening and reported fewer complications with LON [1]. A 2020 systematic review addressed outcomes and complications of cosmetic stature lengthening [8], and series have reported results of cosmetic lower limb LON [9][10].
infobox: Reported in case series and a systematic review

paras: LON was developed to reduce or eliminate frame time during femur lengthening compared with conventional ring-fixator lengthening [1]. Magnetic internal lengthening nails are a related approach that avoids external devices [5]. Reference sources on distraction osteogenesis describe motorised internal nails as an alternative to external devices [11].

In a prospective randomised study of 31 limbs in 28 patients, 15 were lengthened over a nail and 16 conventionally, and the groups were compared on fixation index, consolidation index and complications [3]. A study comparing LON with intramedullary skeletal kinetic distraction found fewer complications with LON [1]. Bilateral tibial LON has been reported with complications and psychological outcomes in a Vietnamese series [10], and results of cosmetic lower limb LON have been published [9]. A study of tibial lengthening found that reamed intramedullary nailing had an adverse effect on bone regeneration during distraction [6]. A 2020 systematic review covers cosmetic stature lengthening outcomes and complications [8]. Related studies include biological enhancement of bone healing in tibial distraction with bone marrow concentrate and platelet-rich plasma [2].

Registered studies include LON pain beliefs and functional performance after cosmetic lengthening (not yet recruiting) [12], postoperative physiotherapy after cosmetic femoral lengthening [13] and video-feedback rehabilitation after bilateral femoral lengthening [14].

Reference sources note that cosmetic stature lengthening is unregulated in some countries, that infection, additional surgeries and shorter-than-expected gains have been reported, and that China's health ministry banned limb lengthening in 2006 after serious side effects [11].

timeline.event: Study reports fewer complications with LON than intramedullary skeletal kinetic distraction [1].
Randomised comparison of LON and conventional Ilizarov lengthening published [3].
Systematic review of cosmetic stature lengthening published [8].
